Reranking with an empty query string

```ruby title="Ruby"

api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.rerank_async(LiterLlm::RerankRequest.new(documents: ['Some document', 'Another document'], model: 'rerank-v3.5', query: ''))
```
